item.title: 完整回忆的代价有多大？智能体记忆系统的服务成本基准测试
item.summary: arXiv:2608.11879v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-running conversational agents increasingly rely on a memory system to avoid resending the whole conversation each turn, yet how much that costs to serve has received little systematic benchmarking.
